items.heading: Moules-Frites
details: Key ingredients: mussels, white wine, shallots, celery, potatoes
Steam cleaned mussels with white wine, shallots and celery until they open.
Discard any mussels that remain closed.
Fry potato strips twice for extra-crisp fries.
Serve the mussels in their broth with a heap of fries.

items.heading: Belgian Waffles
details: Key ingredients: flour, yeast, eggs, butter, milk
Make a yeasted batter with flour, eggs, butter and milk, letting it rise.
Preheat a deep waffle iron and grease it lightly.
Pour batter into the iron and cook until deeply golden and crisp.
Serve warm with powdered sugar, whipped cream or fruit.
